# Checklist for contributions and revisions {#sec-checklist}

<!-- page-provenance:start -->
::: {.page-provenance}
*R. Heller · Date: 2026-05-17 · Last changed: 2026-05-17*
:::
<!-- page-provenance:end -->

For every new edition or revised chapter:

- The purpose, readership and prerequisites of the chapter are stated.
- Authorship and licences of reused sources are correct.
- Every claim, citation, figure caption and cross-reference has been checked; DOIs resolve.
- Every number is labelled as synthetic, published, assumption or open.
- The examples run in a fresh R session; the software status is documented in @sec-edition-notes.
- Legal statements distinguish publication, entry into force and date of application, and state the reference date.
- Navigation, contrast, alternative text, print view and narrow screens have been checked.
- HTML and EPUB output have been inspected before distribution.
- Open issues and the exact edition are recorded in the edition notes.
